heroHeadline: Jharkhand High Court sets firm two-month deadline, Nov 18 compliance report for stalled JPSC appointments
heroSubtitle: Following up on its Sep 3 directive, a Jharkhand High Court bench of Chief Justice M.S. Sonak and Justice Rajesh Shankar formally ordered the state government on Sep 10 to complete appointment of a JPSC Chairperson and members within two months, with a compliance report due Nov 18 and the next hearing Nov 19; the Advocate General assured the bench the process was 'likely to be completed' in that window. The order lands as the BJP's four-day statewide siege of DC/SP offices over cases against JPSC/JSSC protesters concludes its final day, and comes with the underlying commission vacancies — created by the Aug 9 mass resignation of all three JPSC members and Chairperson L. Khiangte's Jul 22 exit — still unresolved. The CJP's internal fracture into CJP and CJP-Democratic, the Bihar TRE-4 notification and the Jamia admissions dispute remain unchanged since their early-September developments.
